expectedEntry.behavior: 已停止的 Build 检查保存了无效 outcome 时，确认原执行停止后可沿原 Run 记录中断并恢复 Builder。
expectedEntry.reproduction: 真实执行 v3 build.checks，保留逐项日志，将持久 outcome 的计划名称替换为旧计划名称，再将原 Action 标记 unknown；旧 doctor 即使收到正确停止证据也无法收敛。
expectedEntry.expected: 正确停止证据将旧 Action 记录为失败中断，保留原记录、日志、Run 和 Shape 批准，恢复 Builder；重复修复不重放，新的显式检查请求仍可完成。
expectedEntry.forbidden: 未确认或错误 claim 推进、跨候选采信结果、丢弃 Run、把坏结果当通过、覆盖坏记录或自动重跑命令。
expectedEntry.rootCause: 中断恢复和校验要求 execution.outcome 不存在，拒绝了存在但校验失败的已停止结果。

migration.reason: Extend the already-retired Issue545 contracts with an actual published 0.5.2 completed-invalid Build frontier: one safe Node check really completed, then only its persisted plan name was changed and the original Action marked unknown. Preserve raw Run/input/claim/Shape approval/history and all four legacy cache bytes through public next/doctor/reload, resume exactly one Builder without candidate/Verifier, stop handshake, fabricated pass or command replay. Original-root actual counter/log/sidecar prove no replay; materialized relative counter proves byte preservation only, because original absolute argv is immutable. Existing frozen retirement evidence and both pending/claimed tests remain unchanged in the chain. The retired stopped-actions repair handshake is not claimed fixed or supported.

expectedEntry.behavior: 无效完整检查结果被拒绝时，doctor 和 next 提供一致且可执行的停止确认入口与具体校验原因。
expectedEntry.reproduction: 向已停止的 build.checks 保留计划不匹配的 outcome，执行 doctor 和 next；旧输出只要求补交无法通过校验的原结果，不提供停止确认参数。
expectedEntry.expected: doctor 说明结果校验失败并给出 confirmed、stopped-actions 参数；next 要求原领取绑定的停止证据，执行该入口后可恢复。
expectedEntry.forbidden: 提供 Build 阶段不可达的 Verifier refreshChecks 指引，或在缺少停止确认入口时静默重复同一无效恢复命令。
expectedEntry.rootCause: doctor、continuation 与恢复入口分别按 outcome 的存在性判断，没有共享结果校验结论。
